title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html

  echo: true

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
```

We read all 67 county precinct files from the official Florida Department of State zip archive, filter to the Republican primary for Governor, and sum the votes for each candidate.

```{r}
# Extract the tab-separated county files into a temporary directory
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

# Read all county files; X12 is office, X15 is candidate, X16 is party, X19 is votes
gov_rep <- read_tsv(files, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE, quote = "") |>
  filter(X12 == "Governor", X16 == "REP") |>
  summarize(votes = sum(as.numeric(X19), na.rm = TRUE), .by = X15) |>
  rename(candidate = X15)

# Plot total votes by candidate, ordered from highest to lowest
gov_rep |>
  ggplot(aes(x = votes, y = fct_reorder(candidate, votes))) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official precinct-level vote totals across all 67 counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
